download_url: download a file from a URL to a specified root directory with optional MD5 verification
download_and_extract_archive: download an archive from a URL and extract it to a specified directory
download_google_drive_url: download a file from Google Drive to a specified output path and file name
get_redirected_url: resolve a URL to its final redirected destination URL
to_google_drive_download_url: convert a Google Drive view URL to a direct download URL
